title: odontarrhena tortuosa subsp. savranica
intro: Odontarrhena tortuosa subsp. savranica, commonly known as Savran Odontarrhena, is a plant species in the family Ranunculaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in medicine, valued for its health benefits, which include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. Its therapeutic actions include being used as a treatment for various conditions, such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Odontarrhena tortuosa subsp. savranica include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
